# Whiteboard

> A free online whiteboard with nothing to sign up for. Open a board, send the link, and whoever opens it is in the room with you: draw, write and move notes together in real time.

Whiteboard is a collaborative canvas at whiteboard.chakkritton.com. There are no accounts: the link is the access. Boards sync live between everyone in the room and are also kept in the browser, so they open offline.

## Features

- Real-time collaboration on a shared link, with live cursors and names
- Sticky notes, text, frames, shapes (rectangle, ellipse, diamond), lines and arrows that stay attached to what they connect
- A smooth pressure-sensitive pen (Apple Pencil works), a highlighter and an eraser
- Pictures by drop, paste or picker
- Planning and software templates: kanban, timeline, retro, mind map, flowchart, architecture, story map, sprint board
- Mr. Worldwide, an AI guide that drafts a plan or flowchart onto the board, summarises it, tidies loose notes into groups, and answers questions about chakkritton.com
- Export as PNG, JPEG, PDF or a JSON file you can import again
- Thai and English, light and dark themes

## How it works

- The room is the URL. There are no accounts, sessions or a database of boards: whoever has the link is in the room.
- The board is a CRDT (Yjs). Two people editing the same note write to different keys, so both edits survive.
- IndexedDB keeps the board in your browser, so it opens instantly and works offline. A websocket relays it to everyone else in the room; the server holds a room in memory only while somebody is in it. What outlives everyone leaving is the copy in each browser and any file you exported.
- Notes are real text (DOM elements), so what is written on them is selectable, editable in place and readable by screen readers.
- Export writes plain JSON (contents, not history); import validates every field.

## Keyboard shortcuts

- V P H E R N T F: select, pen, highlighter, eraser, rectangle, note, text, frame
- Drag on the empty board: sweep a selection · hold Space and drag: move the view · Cmd/Ctrl + wheel: zoom
- Alt + drag a note: pull a copy out of it · right-click: cut, copy, order, lock, group
- Double-click a note: edit it · Cmd/Ctrl + C X V D: copy, cut, paste, duplicate
- Cmd/Ctrl + G: group (with Shift: ungroup) · ] and [: bring to front, send to back
- Delete: remove the selection · Cmd/Ctrl + A: select all · Cmd/Ctrl + Z: undo (with Shift: redo)
